weekly_method: Last accepted daily close in each Monday-Friday week; discard cutoff's incomplete week. No weekly price is filled. Vendor weekly bars are not used.
feature_history: Require 53 consecutive observed weekly records, no known SOX candidate gap within the feature lookback. Closed weeks without quotes are omitted, not filled; feature windows count observed market weeks, not exact calendar weeks.
outcome: Entry reference is next observed weekly close after signal; endpoint is last observed weekly close at/before entry week-label plus h calendar weeks, max 14-day endpoint lag. Record actual entry/end dates. No execution return claim.
outcome_gap_policy: Exclude if any known SOX candidate gap lies between signal week start and endpoint week end, or if any adjacent observed-week labels differ by more than 21 days. Exclude incomplete future endpoints. Never bridge a known provider gap.
segment_rule: Signal and complete outcome endpoint must be within the same segment. Full sample summaries are descriptive. Historical segments are not pristine unseen holdouts; no fitting or rule selection in this phase.
cycle_rule: Retrospective directional-change extrema of observed weekly closes, confirmed only upon threshold reversal. Track extremum date and later confirmation separately; reset after known SOX gap or >21-day weekly gap. Right-censored final extrema are not confirmed turns. 20% primary, 10% sensitivity; neither is a universal sentiment definition.

bootstrap.interval: circular paired-block percentile 95%, conditional mean minus all eligible weeks; no p-values or discovery claim

claim_limit: Current-vintage price-state description only; no point-in-time news, causal identification, strategy return, sentiment factor efficacy or independent replication claim. Earlier OECD/FRED pilot is a different input/design and not pooled.
seed_scope: Bootstrap Monte Carlo only; deterministic features and labels have no training seed.
